correction: SDDM reads /etc/sddm.conf after /etc/sddm.conf.d, so an active [Autologin] User= there won over the probe's zz- drop-in. login-setup.sh now comments out the active User=, Session= and Relogin= lines of that section (keeping the file mode, never creating the file), and the probe reports autologin false while such a line stays active.
